description: Feature list for the AI News reference application. Only one phase may be active at a time. Transition to passing requires verification exit 0 plus human sign-off.
_recommended_final_phase: The final phase evaluates the real runtime security path and records measurable evidence without starting new work.

features.name: Project setup and runtime-security wiring
features.behavior: Project context, governance policy, framework integration design, and testable runtime-security adapter contract are in place before application tools execute.
features.evidence: Human-approved local verification on 2026-08-18: 12 passed in 0.44s.

features.name: News retrieval tools
features.behavior: Approved news and GitHub retrieval tools can fetch public data through the runtime permission/egress boundary and return screened results.
features.evidence: Human-approved local verification on 2026-08-18: 11 passed in 0.57s.

features.name: Strands Claude agent integration
features.behavior: The Strands agent uses only registered secured wrapper tools; raw handlers are not registered and directory auto-loading is disabled.

features.name: Streamlit application
features.behavior: A local Streamlit page shows the daily digest/chat plus visible runtime protection status and audit events.

features.name: Runtime enforcement tests
features.behavior: E01-E06 integration/E2E cases prove allow/deny/block/suspicious outcomes and verify denied handlers do not execute.

features.name: Evaluation and snapshot
features.behavior: The existing evaluation framework measures runtime-security decision accuracy, reproducibility, latency, and provider cost when available, and produces human-reviewable evidence.
